children: Air IQ, a travel tech firm, has confidentially filed draft papers with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for an initial public offering (IPO) to raise around Rs 1,000 crore, as per sources familiar with the matter.

The draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) was filed yesterday, and the offering comprises a mix of offer for sale and fresh issue. Around 60 percent of the issue will be an OFS, while the remained will be the fresh issue component, added the source on conditions of anonymity.
The promoters and promoter family will be selling a portion of their shares in ten OFS.
Pantomath Capital Advisors is the sole book running lead manager or merchant banker for the IPO.

Air IQ is a Siliguri, West Bengal based B2B travel technology and distribution company connecting airlines, hotels, travel agencies, and technology partners through one integrated ecosystem. The platform helps agencies manage search, booking, ticketing and post-booking operations from one connected environment.

The current calendar year has already seen more than 80 main board issues till date cumulatively raising nearly Rs 1.10 lakh crore - the third consecutive calendar year when IPO fund raising breached the psychological Rs 1 lakh crore mark.

title: Air IQ files confidential DRHP for Rs 1,000 crore IPO
